name: Glitter Dark
summary:
GlitterDark is an audioreactive VR visualizer that transforms sound into a living visual environment.

Every beat, frequency, and rhythm directly drives dynamic visuals in real time. Bass, mids, highs, and energy shape what you see, creating a fully immersive audiovisual experience.

The app supports both music files and custom radio streams, allowing you to bring your own audio into the experience.
